claim_ceiling: Public formal, differential, property, and mutation evidence through proof level 4 only.

required_properties.rule: ISSUE contains exactly ten distinct valid physical location IDs; otherwise ABSTAIN_NO_VALID_TEN.
Protected true, unresolved, or conflicting protection states never clear.
Only Stage-1 evidence observed at or before decision_as_of affects the result.
Input permutation does not change the selected set or abstention decision.
Bounded candidate domains match exhaustive feasible-set enumeration with deterministic lexicographic tie-breaking.
Version 1 uses exact epsilon_B=0: proximity is a tie-break only among primary-value-maximizing lists.
Unknown or symbolic empirical inputs cannot carry numeric values or produce trial-size/economic recommendations.
Predictive probability and causal ITT effect remain distinct estimands.
Derived proof level cannot exceed the weakest load-bearing input.

power_output_until_inputs_exist.reason: required empirical and human-authoritative inputs are unset

required_negative_controls.expected_diagnostic: MATH-P02 protected or unresolved candidate cleared
MATH-P01 physical locations are not distinct
MATH-P03 post-decision evidence affected Stage-1 policy
MATH-P08 decision estimand is undefined or conflated
MATH-P07 power result uses unset inputs
MATH-P07 scenario value promoted to measured evidence
MATH-P04 input permutation changed the result
MATH-P05 candidate policy differs from exhaustive oracle

implementation_gate: Do not credit reference-oracle implementation until the public evaluator independently detects every required negative control and rejects missing registry/schema/differential artifacts.
